from solution import max_path_sum


def test_issue_example():
    """Issue example: max_path_sum([[1,0,0],[4,8,0],[1,5,3]],2,2) == 14."""
    assert max_path_sum([[1, 0, 0], [4, 8, 0], [1, 5, 3]], 2, 2) == 14  # 1+8+5=14


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Issue: single-element triangle returns that element."""
    assert max_path_sum([[5]], 0, 0) == 5  # 5=5


def test_issue_two_rows():
    """Issue: two-row triangle picks the larger reachable child."""
    assert max_path_sum([[2, 0], [3, 4]], 1, 1) == 6  # 2+4=6


def test_issue_greedy_trap():
    """Issue: must look ahead, not greedily pick the larger child."""
    tri = [[1, 0, 0], [2, 3, 0], [10, 1, 1]]
    assert max_path_sum(tri, 2, 2) == 13  # 1+2+10=13


def test_issue_negative_values():
    """Issue: maximum path works with all-negative values."""
    assert max_path_sum([[-1, 0], [-2, -3]], 1, 1) == -3  # -1+-2=-3


def test_issue_left_edge_best():
    """Issue: maximum path can stay on the left edge."""
    tri = [[1, 0, 0], [10, 1, 0], [20, 1, 1]]
    assert max_path_sum(tri, 2, 2) == 31  # 1+10+20=31


def test_issue_right_edge_best():
    """Issue: maximum path can stay on the right edge."""
    tri = [[1, 0, 0], [1, 10, 0], [1, 1, 20]]
    assert max_path_sum(tri, 2, 2) == 31  # 1+10+20=31


def test_issue_four_rows():
    """Issue: maximum path over four rows follows adjacent entries."""
    tri = [[3, 0, 0, 0], [7, 4, 0, 0], [2, 4, 6, 0], [8, 5, 9, 3]]
    assert max_path_sum(tri, 3, 3) == 23  # 3+7+4+9=23


def test_issue_row_maxima_unreachable():
    """Issue: cannot just sum each row's maximum, path must be adjacent."""
    tri = [[5, 0, 0], [1, 100, 0], [100, 1, 1]]
    assert max_path_sum(tri, 2, 2) == 106  # 5+1+100=106


def test_contract_keyword_args():
    """Contract: max_path_sum(tri, m, n) accepts arguments by name."""
    tri = [[1, 0, 0], [4, 8, 0], [1, 5, 3]]
    assert max_path_sum(tri=tri, m=2, n=2) == 14  # 1+8+5=14


def test_contract_returns_number():
    """Contract: max_path_sum returns a number for the documented example."""
    result = max_path_sum([[1, 0, 0], [4, 8, 0], [1, 5, 3]], 2, 2)
    assert isinstance(result, (int, float))


def test_contract_deterministic():
    """Contract: max_path_sum returns the same value on repeated calls."""
    tri = [[1, 0, 0], [4, 8, 0], [1, 5, 3]]
    first = max_path_sum(tri, 2, 2)  # 1+8+5=14
    second = max_path_sum(tri, 2, 2)  # 1+8+5=14
    assert first == second == 14  # 1+8+5=14
